## Description {#details}

<p>Struct template representing a floating point value with precision control.</p>


<dl class="doxyParamsList">
<dt class="doxyParamsTableTitle">Template Parameters</dt>
<dd>
<table class="doxyParamsTable">
<tr class="doxyParamItem">
<td class="doxyParamItemName">T</td>
<td class="doxyParamItemDescription"><p>The floating point type to be encapsulated.</p></td>
</tr>
</table>
</dd>
</dl>

<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/value">value</a></span> struct template specialisation for floating point types encapsulates a value of type <span class="doxyComputerOutput">T</span> and provides an associated <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#adbc4320a0bdfc8bcc0cdf255639af0f2">epsilon</a></span> for precision control during comparisons. The stored value, explicit conversion operator, and getter are provided by the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/value-base">value_base</a></span> base.</p>


<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="#adbc4320a0bdfc8bcc0cdf255639af0f2">epsilon</a></span> member defines the precision used for floating point comparisons and can be set explicitly (by <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-function-comparators/#gacae776e46a799b81af859ba9bb74e7d0">approx()</a></span>) or computed as a default based on the number of decimal digits in the value (by the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-literals/#ga5368740b47e92605914b6c38ea88aebf">to_f</a></span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-literals/#ga9608f4a6f0a61bc159a66a46fb8cd630">to_d</a></span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/groups/micro-os-plus-micro-test-plus-literals/#gaeba32254fdd8159523b525745b13bfa9">to_ld</a></span> wrappers).</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>The epsilon value used for floating-point comparisons.</p>


<p>This instance member defines the precision for comparisons. It is set via the constructor, either explicitly or computed as a default based on the number of decimal digits in the value. Each instance carries its own epsilon, so two <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/value">value</a>&lt;T&gt;</span> objects with different precisions do not interfere with each other.</p>
